[Today, 6:05 pm] User: Quick one. I cut my hand quite deeply on the rusty edge of our outdoor bin about an hour ago. It's stopped bleeding. I can't remember when I last had a tetanus jab, probably at school, I'm 38 now. Do I need to do anything?

Write Ease's reply to the latest message.
response:
I’m so sorry to hear about your hand—that sounds painful. 

Because you aren't certain about when your last tetanus shot was and the injury involved a rusty outdoor surface, **please reach out to a healthcare professional or visit an urgent care clinic as soon as you can.** 

Tetanus boosters are generally recommended every 10 years, and it is much safer to have a medical professional evaluate the wound and your vaccination status. In the meantime, ensure the area is cleaned thoroughly with soap and water and kept covered with a clean bandage. 

Please don't wait on this—better to be safe and get it checked out tonight! Keep me posted on how you’re doing.
